posts.subject: Admin info addition
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Dream Community,



As some of you might have noticed recently I have made some translations for "Forum Ranks" etc...


My idea was for this translations to appear in the admin info next to original posts, it would look something like this.


[Bild]



Share your opinions if you think that's a good idea to make it easier for German non speakers 🙂

Test-Admins have rights on: 1 Server
Administrators have rights on: 2 Servers
Administrator+ have rights on: 4 Servers + CS:S
Super Admins have rights on: all CS:GO + CS:S Servers
Head Admins have rights on: all Servers
